name: currency-brl
description: Monetary input formatted in Brazilian Real (R$) with optional installment display

behavior.format: Brazilian locale: dot for thousands, comma for decimals (R$ 1.499,90)
behavior.internalStorage: Stores value in cents internally, converts to reais on output

context.whenToUse: Any input that accepts monetary values in Brazilian Real
context.accessibility: R$ prefix is visually separate, input announces currency context
context.culturalNote: Brazil uses comma as decimal separator and dot as thousands separator. R$ 1.499,90 means one thousand four hundred ninety-nine reais and ninety centavos. Installment display ('10x de R$ 149,99 sem juros') is standard in Brazilian e-commerce.
